summary: For each nonzero source cell, compute its Chebyshev ring. A ring corner copies its color to all four corners; a non-corner witness fills the step-two lattice positions along all four sides. Sources are processed in reading order. The calibrated lesson grammar presents consistently oriented nested odd-radius corners, with an optional same-colored inward witness pair naming each side role.
